existingClaim.title: Existing model PVC
existingClaim.description: (Optional) An existing PVC containing /models/gguf. ReadWriteOnce, so it is valid for a single replica of a single model.

size.title: Model volume size
size.description: Capacity requested for each dynamically provisioned model volume. One model per volume; the largest single artifact is 21.6 GiB, and a multimodal profile's weights and vision projector are counted together (Gemma 4: 21.6 GiB plus 1.1 GiB).

azimuthNodeGroupSelector.title: GPU node group
azimuthNodeGroupSelector.description: (Optional) Node group defined in your Kubernetes platform to schedule inference engine on.
